name: Major floods
summary: No GDACS orange or red flood alerts on 20 Nov; one green-level flood event listed
state: GDACS listed no orange or red flood alerts at 05:41 UTC on 20 Nov, only one green-level flood event worldwide (GDACS). Heavy rain from Cyclone Akvan, which crossed the Odisha–Andhra coast on 20 Nov, is tracked under the cyclone signal.
for_you: No major flood alert is in force worldwide. Travellers to coastal eastern India should follow IMD and local authority warnings.

sources.title: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System

why: Floods affect more people than any other hazard, displacing millions each year.
drivers: Extreme rainfall, monsoons, cyclones, snowmelt, dam failures.

rubric.alert: GDACS red flood alert, or > 100 deaths in a single event.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange flood alert, or a flood displacing > 50,000.
